title: TIDE: Token-Level Credit Assignment via Entropy-Gated Bounded Deviation
abstract: arXiv:2605.03327v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is central for aligning large language models (LLMs) with complex reasoning, yet the leading critic-free algorithm, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), broadcasts a single sequence-level advantage uniformly across long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generations and constrains exploration with an unbounded Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty, which dilutes token-level supervision and induces gradient instability and mode-seeking conservatism. We propose TIDE (Token-level Importance via Deviation and Entropy), a critic-free RL framework that reinterprets distribution deviation as a guiding signal rather than a rigid penalty. TIDE replaces the volatile reverse KL divergence with the bounded Hellinger distance, safely quantifying token-level exploration without risk of gradient explosion. To separate genuine reasoning breakthroughs from confident hallucinations, an entropy gating mechanism scales this deviation

translated_title: TIDE：基于熵门控有界偏差的令牌级信用分配
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）对于将大语言模型（LLM）与复杂推理能力对齐至关重要，然而当前领先的无评论家（critic-free）算法——组相对策略优化（GRPO），将单一的序列级优势信号均匀地广播到整个长思维链（CoT）生成过程中，并使用无界的KL散度惩罚来约束探索，这稀释了令牌级别的监督信号，导致梯度不稳定和模式寻求式的保守性。我们提出了TIDE（通过偏差和熵实现令牌级重要性），这是一个无评论家的RL框架，它将分布偏差重新诠释为指导信号，而非僵化的惩罚。TIDE用有界的Hellinger距离替代了不稳定的反向KL散度，在无梯度爆炸风险的情况下安全地量化令牌级别的探索。为了区分真正的推理突破与自信的幻觉，熵门控机制对该偏差进行缩放调节。
tldr: TIDE框架用有界的Hellinger距离替代GRPO中无界的KL惩罚，并引入熵门控机制来区分真实推理突破与幻觉，从而实现了对长思维链生成中令牌级监督的精确信用分配。
en_tdlr: TIDE replaces GRPO's unbounded KL penalty with bounded Hellinger distance and introduces entropy gating to distinguish genuine reasoning breakthroughs from confident hallucinations, enabling precise token-level credit assignment in critic-free RL.
